1. Set G_0 to the image.
2. Reduce G_k to G_{k+1} for each level, with the border mode at the edges of each level.
3. Take each detail level L_k as G_k minus the expansion of G_{k+1}.
4. Start the rebuild with the top level G_L.
5. For k from L - 1 down to 0, expand the rebuilt level and add a_k times L_k.
